faq.question: What does Kartini mean?
faq.answer: Kartini is associated with the Javanese form كَرْتِينِي, whose core sense is kartini; a javanese female given name.

faq.question: What is the origin of Kartini?
faq.answer: Kartini is associated with Javanese. Kartini is a Javanese (Indonesian) female given name, notably borne by Raden Adjeng Kartini.

faq.question: Is Kartini an Arabic name?
faq.answer: No — the underlying form is Javanese, not Arabic.

faq.question: Is Kartini an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Kartini can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Javanese-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Kartini a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Kartini should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Kartini is a Javanese name, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.question: What does Kartini mean in Persian?

faq.answer: A romanized syllable approximation is kar-ti-ni. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.answer: Romanization variants include Kartini, kartini. Script forms are كَرْتِينِي, کارتینی, کرتيني, کرتینی, कर्तिनी.
